reviews.review:
UPDATE:
Now having close to 12 hours in game. Since my last review the Developer has been consistently updating the game and has listened to the players adding luck stat variants, as well as adjusted the difficulty to have longer more rewarding runs, also the update adding a new map as well as upgrading the visuals on each map. This is also within a week! If they add of a reroll system it would be a positive to the game having 3 maximum rerolls a run could potentially help someone that is in need of a specific trait on "level up", especially if its deep in a run. Maybe soon classes or to grind to buy certain weapons maybe from the menu. I don't know but I am hopeful for this project! Good job from the Developer! 




After playing a couple hours, the game is pretty chill and at 2.99 sale its worth 3 bucks. Scaling and difficulty needs some adjustment but overall pretty good. A couple PROS is leveling specific traits and trying to develop builds you can feel the difference between each trait. It is also pretty smooth and again is chill to play. A couple CONS I would say it needs some type of luck stat to get better augments or upgrading becomes better, a reroll system for the augments on the level up. Also it would be pretty cool if you could choose the character that you start the round with because characters look cooler than others. Overall thumbs up for me first day launch, it definitely will get as the developer keeps with good updates.
